parameters: Dear Sister...\| My shame knows no bounds...
You are my Bonded, until death.\! What matters most is that you are alive.
That black knight...\| he slayed all of the warriors.\! The cultists gave us a choice - to serve them or watch the children die.
I do not know.\! They were all taken away.\! To be "re-educated" to serve Zanatus.\! They killed any priestesses who dared to object...
...At least, we Bonded are reunited.\! It is time for you to go to war, Edelia. By my side.
I will spend my entire life's blood for you, Sister. May we be whole once again.
